name: jiangshan-map
description: 江山时序 · 中国历史交互地图时间轴 (403 BCE – Present) | Interactive Historical Atlas of China across 18 dynasties, 198 territory snapshots, ancient-to-modern place genealogy & classical poetry routes
one_liner: An interactive map that lets you scrub through 2,400+ years of Chinese history and watch territory and place names change dynasty by dynasty.
buyer: A history teacher or educational publisher who wants an engaging visual tool for teaching Chinese history, or a museum building an exhibit.
business_use_cases: A history teacher uses it in class as an interactive timeline instead of static textbook maps.
An educational app publisher licenses the underlying data/visualization to embed in a paid history-learning app.
A museum or cultural center licenses a kiosk version for an exhibit on Chinese history.

money_ideas.idea: Build a polished, ad-supported or premium education app version targeted at schools and history enthusiasts.
License the dataset/visualization engine to educational publishers for a flat fee.

steal_this: Wrap this in a simple classroom-friendly web app with a 'teacher mode' and pitch it directly to a few history teachers this weekend.
